name: Nagumo Kenta
source:
A fellow voice actor at Nadeshiko Productions.
His nickname is Gumon.
An enthusiastic and bright guy, he usually voices characters in kid's anime, but he likes robots and things like that so he's satisfied with his job.
He's friends with [url=/c41182]Kai[/url] because they are close in age and they often go out to eat after work.
translation:
A fellow voice actor at Nadeshiko Productions.
His nickname is Gumon.
An enthusiastic and bright guy, he usually voices characters in kid's anime, but he likes robots and things like that so he's satisfied with his job.
He's friends with [url=/c41182]Kai[/url] because they are close in age and they often go out to eat after work.
